domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved (search engine returned connection errors; thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403). Only company self-description available: indianacrylics.com homepage states "Indian Acrylics Ltd is the largest and most efficient acrylic fiber manufacturer of India and an important player in the global industry with exports to Asia, Europe and the Middle East" and lists products Acrylic Fibre / Acrylic Tow / Acrylic Tops, plus an "E-tender Login" link (a portal exists, but no tender award record was seen). This is a claim, not a verified domestic supply record. Source counter: 1 company page read, 0 domestic transaction records seen.
note: Declared HS 550630 (acrylic staple fibre, not carded/combed) does not match the observed export lines, which are HS 55033090 (acrylic staple fibre, not carded/combed, other), 55093200 and 55093100 (yarn of acrylic staple fibres, not retail) — the company is a genuine acrylic fibre/yarn producer and exporter, so the mismatch is a code correction, not a rejection ground. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is wrong: actual activity is man-made textile fibre (acrylic fibre, tow, tops, yarn), plant at Village Harkishanpura, Bhawanigarh, Sangrur district, Punjab. Export shipments are factual and dated (Feb 2026, Morocco and Italy, with B/L numbers). Domestic supply: no public GST/tender/contract record found in this session — status declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in the sources read).
